$comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. The PII service's database schema is NOT documented in the integration guide.
Copy to config/db-queries.json (git-ignored) and replace every <PLACEHOLDER> with SQL confirmed by the PII backend team.
Rules: read-only SELECT/WITH only; one statement; bind params with the engine's placeholders ($1.. for postgres, ? for mysql);
'params' lists the named parameters in placeholder order; each query MUST return the column aliases listed in docs/database-setup.md.
Set a query to null if it cannot be supported; dependent DB tests then fail with an actionable message.

findPiiRecords.sql: SELECT <tenant_col> AS tenant_id, <user_col> AS user_id, <field_col> AS field, <ciphertext_col> AS encrypted_value, <key_version_col> AS key_version FROM <pii_table> WHERE <tenant_col> = $1 AND <user_col> = $2 AND <field_col> = $3

findTransientPhone.sql: SELECT <tenant_col> AS tenant_id, <caller_col> AS caller_id, <ciphertext_col> AS encrypted_value, <expires_col> AS expires_at, (<consumed_col> IS NOT NULL) AS is_consumed FROM <transient_table> WHERE <id_col> = $1

findFreeTextKey.sql: SELECT <tenant_col> AS tenant_id, <caller_col> AS caller_id, <status_col> AS status, <revoked_at_col> AS revoked_at, <wrapped_key_col> AS encrypted_key_material FROM <free_text_key_table> WHERE <id_col> = $1
